strongest_angle: Examine Interact MCP's new enterprise intranet Model Context Protocol server connection, detailing how it securely integrates internal knowledge bases and user permissions with large language model assistants.

key_facts.fact: Tom Walters, VP of Product at Interact, introduced Interact MCP as a permission-aware connection built for large enterprises on the foundation of Cue and Conductor.
Interact MCP brings corporate intranet data into compatible AI environments including Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Gemini Enterprise, Workday Sana, and SAP Joule.
The Vinkius partner platform lists the Interact Software MCP connector for Claude with 10 official tools for managing intranet people, content, and groups.
